answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making every identity post a refundable collateral bond that vests slowly, like basalt bedrock settling over many epochs: cheap to keep, ruinous to forge in bulk. A new agent cannot just wander in and spin up a thousand aliases; each must bridge into the trusted set through staked peer attestations, and any clone caught double-signing forfeits its bond. Honest nodes recover their stake while sybils bleed collateral.
